digest.component_or_area: linting and code quality: ARG (unused argument) violations across src/rebar
propositions: ruff --select ARG src/rebar reports 64 violations (48 ARG001, 14 ARG002, 2 ARG005) requiring disposition into six buckets: tracked defects (excluded), Cluster-1 reconciler leaves (normalize to **_kwargs), Cluster-2 Protocol conformance (# noqa: ARG002), keyword-unsafe renames (# noqa with reason), interface-pinned positional dispatch (safe _-prefix), and plain mechanical safe renames

Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers (10 sites across apply_inbound.py and apply_outbound.py) require normalization to **_kwargs rather than individual renames to avoid breaking runtime dispatch via string introspection (accepts_repo_root, accepts_binding_store) and unconditional keyword parameter passing (client)

Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol parameters (7 sites in jira_datacenter/backend.py and jira_family/outbound_mapper.py) are pinned by Protocol contract and keyword call sites, making rename-unsafe; must remain raw residuals because RUF100 (unused-noqa) is enabled in pyproject, causing # noqa: ARG00x lines to fail linting

Three tracked real defects (timeout_s in ticket 7504-a127-e9b0-42bb, close_reason in 3803-8e04-7c32-4b80, acli_cmd bug) must be excluded from sweep and left in place; any new possible-defect surfaced must be filed separately with discovered_from link
ARG must NOT be added to pyproject.toml select by this ticket; post-sweep irreducible count (21 violations) must be recorded as a ticket comment to inform future ARG gate revisit decision

binding_store side effect of **_kwargs normalization in Cluster-1 requires test verification that leaves now receiving binding_store produce identical observable results, proving behaviour preservation
